# Detailed Content of the TOSTEM Website Page


## **Header Section**
- **Brand Name**: TOSTEM (displayed prominently in large, bold gray text at the top-left corner)
- **Tagline**: "Japanese Innovation in Window Design" (smaller gray text to the right of the brand name)


## **Navigation Menu (Top Bar)**
A horizontal menu bar with the following items (all in white text on a dark gray background, each followed by a downward arrow icon indicating a dropdown menu):
1. ABOUT TOSTEM
2. WHY TOSTEM
3. OUR PRODUCT
4. DRIVING EXPERIENCE
5. TADA
6. KNOWLEDGE EXPERIENCE
7. REACH US


## **Main Visual Section (Hero Image)**
- **Image Content**: A man in a dark suit stands with his back to the viewer, facing large panoramic corner sliding doors that open to a view of the ocean and sky. The scene is bright and airy, emphasizing the doors’ ability to connect indoor and outdoor spaces.
- **Overlay Text (on the right side of the image)**:
  - **Product Name**: "Panoramic Corner Sliding Doors" (large, light gray text)
  - **Tagline**: "Widen the view of the world. Unbound limitless beauty of your space." (smaller light gray text below the product name)


## **Sidebar Elements**
- **Left Sidebar**: A vertical black button with white text: "DOWNLOAD BROCHURE"
- **Right Sidebar**: A vertical black button with white text: "ENQUIRE NOW"
- **Floating Phone Icon**: A circular blue icon with a white phone symbol, located in the top-right corner of the page (likely a contact shortcut)


## **Cookie Consent Banner (Bottom of Page)**
- **Text**: "We use cookies on our website to give you the most relevant experience by remembering your preferences and repeat visits. By clicking “Accept”, you consent to the use of ALL the cookies." (small, dark gray text)
- **Buttons**:
  - "Cookie settings" (white text on a transparent background, likely a link)
  - "ACCEPT" (white text on a black background, a clickable button)


## **Additional Notes**
- The overall design is clean and modern, with a focus on minimalism and high-quality visuals to highlight the product’s aesthetic and functional benefits.
- The color scheme uses neutral tones (gray, black, white) with a pop of blue (phone icon) to maintain a professional, sophisticated look.
